body:
I hope you’re proud to tell your loved ones that you’re a key part of the DLCC’s grassroots team committed to electing Democrats who help families in need year-round. | | |
---
| |
---|---
💫 Happy Holiday Season, Peter, Before the holiday season kicks into high gear, I wanted to personally reach out to you to express my sincere gratitude for your support of the DLCC this year. To me, the holidays are a grounding opportunity for reflection and appreciation. Today wouldn’t have felt complete unless I took a minute to thank you for supporting the DLCC’s mission to increase Democratic power in America’s state legislatures. **Together, we’re winning elections, making the most effective investments, and fighting for the future we believe in.** Peter, there is something incredibly special about our ballot level. The DLCC’s candidates aren’t just representing their districts; they live there, they go to the grocery store there, and they are amongst their constituents every single day – they never lose sight of what voters care about most, and neither do we. I hope you’re proud to tell your loved ones that you’re a key part of the DLCC’s grassroots team committed to electing Democrats who help families in need year-round – supporting food banks, providing meals for students, protecting affordable health care access, and so much more. **With you on our side, we can serve our communities every day, not just on holidays.** In the coming weeks and months, you’ll hear more from my team about our upcoming elections, but for now, please enjoy your holiday season kickoff, and please know how grateful we are for you, Peter. clean_body: I hope you’re proud to tell your loved ones that you’re a key part of the DLCC’s grassroots team committed to electing Democrats who help families in need year-round. | | | | | ---|--- 💫 Happy Holiday Season, Peter, Before the holiday season kicks into high gear, I wanted to personally reach out to you to express my sincere gratitude for your support of the DLCC this year. To me, the holidays are a grounding opportunity for reflection and appreciation. Today wouldn’t have felt complete unless I took a minute to thank you for supporting the DLCC’s mission to increase Democratic power in America’s state legislatures. Together, we’re winning elections, making the most effective investments, and fighting for the future we believe in. Peter, there is something incredibly special about our ballot level. The DLCC’s candidates aren’t just representing their districts; they live there, they go to the grocery store there, and they are amongst their constituents every single day – they never lose sight of what voters care about most, and neither do we. I hope you’re proud to tell your loved ones that you’re a key part of the DLCC’s grassroots team committed to electing Democrats who help families in need year-round – supporting food banks, providing meals for students, protecting affordable health care access, and so much more. With you on our side, we can serve our communities every day, not just on holidays. In the coming weeks and months, you’ll hear more from my team about our upcoming elections, but for now, please enjoy your holiday season kickoff, and please know how grateful we are for you, Peter. name: Chris Pappas
subject: Full of gratitude
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=10011%2E582294%2ExFGg22)
Happy Thanksgiving, friend.
I hope you’re able to unplug and enjoy the holiday surrounded by family and friends. Before you log off, I want to take a moment to say thank you.
This Thanksgiving I have a lot to be grateful for, and you’re a big reason why. It was your support -- whether you knocked on doors, made phone calls, put a sign in your yard, chipped in what you could, or talked to your neighbors about why this race matters -- that elected me as New Hampshire’s next U.S. Senator.
Together we built a movement of people who believe in a freer, fairer future -- and now that future is within our reach.
Every time you showed up for this campaign, in big ways and small, it mattered. I’m thankful for your support and the faith you’ve put in me. It means more than I can say, and I’ll carry that gratitude with me every day as I get to work delivering for New Hampshire in the Senate.
For now I’m looking forward to spending time with my family and loved ones. Moments like this one remind me what this work is really about: making life easier for families gathered around tables just like ours.
So from my family here in Manchester to yours, Happy Thanksgiving! I hope you have a wonderful holiday full of good food and time with the people you love.
Warmly,
Chris

name: Paige Cognetti
subject: One thing I’m thankful for
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Paige for PA
body:
Peter,

Thanksgiving gives us a chance to slow down and remember what matters most.

I’m grateful for the neighbors who check in on one another, the families who make room at the table, and everyone who gives their time to strengthen our communities. Across Northeastern Pennsylvania, I see that care every day. It reminds me why I love public service.

Government should work as hard as the people it serves. Building that kind of government starts with the same values we bring to our neighborhoods: honesty, responsibility, and a willingness to show up for one another.

I’m thankful you’re part of this team. Your encouragement and presence mean the world to me, and simply reading this message is already a meaningful way to stay connected.

From my family to yours, I hope your Thanksgiving brings warmth, rest, and time with the people you love.

With gratitude,

Paige Cognetti

name: Andrew Sypher, Turning Point USA
subject: If you love America, read this first
body:
I’m going to be blunt with you.

| | |
---
| | Friend,
---
I'm going to be blunt with you.

We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit.

Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way."

Right now.

And the scariest part?

It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms.

High schools. Colleges.

Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped.

If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: _" What happened to this country?" _

You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly.

Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything...

The other side is doing something far more dangerous.

They're raising the next generation.

Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places.

That's how countries are lost.

Slowly. Then all at once.

But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope...

There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged.

_And it shouldn 't even exist. _

**Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.**
That alone felt like a miracle.

Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have.

Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down.

And yet...

_They stepped up anyway. _

About that time, Charlie called me.

He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent.

"Andrew, we've got to move faster."

I told him we were. He stopped me.

"No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I actually laughed.

"Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said. "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000."

I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools.

We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet.

But Charlie wasn't fazed.

_" We'll figure it out." _

That was him.

He didn't wait for perfect conditions.

Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... _we lose everything. _

And now?

Less than a year later...

---
**We 're in 3,300 schools. **

**Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. **

**Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. **

_That shouldn 't be possible. _

Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day.

And yet... it's still happening.

_But Friend, here 's the part you need to understand: _

This is not a victory. It's a foothold.

_Because in the other 87% of schools? _

There is no resistance. None.

Just one-sided propaganda from the Left.

One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them.

That's the reality.

The question isn't whether we're fighting. We are.

The question is whether it's enough.

Because right now, the students stepping up through Club America...

They're not the majority. _They 're the exception. _

They're the ones willing to take the heat.

The ones willing to stand alone.

The ones willing to risk being targeted just to say: _" I love this country." _
---
[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckb2u2zAMRp9G3hyYkiLHg4cCgbfboSjQUaAlKiGuZbn6SdG3L3KTJ-hKfjwED3992A_kjffbd4w05xpsLpbD39S29CCMlNlhJvT1ziVYOUjTA_TSWHSVH2Q1dn72ziO4jmYYp_MI0sipu89GE1xCcADgMeCgPIDW4MLqdZiM63h-8gCkgXFQ2pwuq_OrDFMAuIxIWugBN8r1lOlo68YO94rlM6Ts6ORS7Lb5XutRhPom5CLkUsi1TCfcyaf6TAi51JZ33m_9kXivfSso5DJO57CeR-onmlSvyWM_EakewyWEMwEZQqGWklp2ZF3yJNT1x88FjBoBhDStRhvJc4tCXSkib-_ia0So6x2zx_Jp0f1-txzGA_m2C3WtRyv4Usglfml9hyrlJ7LLsz_-8LZxMaPQw-254uvk-p9feszyXwAAAP__jzKkdg)

And every time one of those students raises their hand...

We have a choice.

Back them. _Or leave them on their own. _

**Because when a student starts a chapter, we send them an activism kit -- with American flags. Pocket Constitutions. Leadership tools. **

Everything they need to actually stand their ground.

Not symbolically. For real.

They've already made the decision to lead.

All they're waiting on... is you and me.

**Each activism kit costs $25. That 's it. **

$25 to make sure one student doesn't have to stand alone against the Left in a hostile school.

$25 to put real tools in their hands.

$25 to push back -- even if it's one campus at a time.

**[And Friend, I'm asking you to send backup to these brave students on the frontlines with your gift to Turning Point USA today.](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckb2u2zAMRp9G3hyYkiLHg4cCgbfboSjQUaAlKiGuZbn6SdG3L3KTJ-hKfjwED3992A_kjffbd4w05xpsLpbD39S29CCMlNlhJvT1ziVYOUjTA_TSWHSVH2Q1dn72ziO4jmYYp_MI0sipu89GE1xCcADgMeCgPIDW4MLqdZiM63h-8gCkgXFQ2pwuq_OrDFMAuIxIWugBN8r1lOlo68YO94rlM6Ts6ORS7Lb5XutRhPom5CLkUsi1TCfcyaf6TAi51JZ33m_9kXivfSso5DJO57CeR-onmlSvyWM_EakewyWEMwEZQqGWklp2ZF3yJNT1x88FjBoBhDStRhvJc4tCXSkib-_ia0So6x2zx_Jp0f1-txzGA_m2C3WtRyv4Usglfml9hyrlJ7LLsz_-8LZxMaPQw-254uvk-p9feszyXwAAAP__jzKkdg)**

But here's what gives me hope, Friend...

Club America isn't slowing down. It's accelerating.

Because every day, more students are stepping forward.

Not because it's easy or popular...

_But because they know what 's at stake. _

They're starting chapters in schools where they were told not to.

They're speaking truth in classrooms where the Left once went unchallenged.

They're choosing courage in places designed to make them conform.

And they're not alone.

They're finding each other. They're bringing more students with them every day.

They're building something real -- rooted in faith and freedom, grounded in truth, and unafraid to say that America is worth defending.

That's how movements are built.

Not from the top down... _But from the ground up. _

One student. One school. One chapter at a time.

And Friend -- that's exactly how we take this country back.

But only if we move fast enough.

Because the Left isn't slowing down. They're not taking a break.

They're not afraid to push their anti-American ideas in every classroom they're in.

And if we don't match that urgency... if we don't meet that moment with equal conviction...

Then the generational window Charlie Kirk opened to save our country closes.

And once it closes... It closes for good.

body:
| This Thanksgiving, I am thinking of our struggling communities.
---
Hi Derek, it’s Adam. I didn’t want to let this Thanksgiving go by without thanking you personally. Whether you’ve donated to my campaign, signed one of our petitions, or simply kept up with our work by reading these emails — thank you for staying involved. Together, we changed the course of our country’s future by securing the Democratic majorities we need to tackle the cost-of-living crisis head-on. _None of it would have been possible without you._ I’m ready to work with my colleagues in the Senate to bring costs down for working people — but for many families across America, the results of this election won’t change the immediate struggles they are facing this holiday season. Under the most corrupt administration in American history, our communities have faced rising costs for everyday goods and devastating cuts to the assistance they rely upon. This Thanksgiving, I’m thinking of those families. **[Will you join me in contributing to the Los Angeles Regional Food Bank, the San Francisco-Marin Food Bank, and the Sacramento Food Bank& Family Services? 100% of your donation goes directly to these food banks to help families across the Golden State.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/8120?t=7&refcode=aschiff_email_112626_thanksgiving&akid=10961%2E5257348%2EMvQPMh)** | | [MAKE A DONATION→](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/8120?t=8&refcode=aschiff_email_112626_thanksgiving&akid=10961%2E5257348%2EMvQPMh)

I'm Eduardo Verastegui. I produced the movie _Sound of Freedom_.

I'm so glad I found **you.**

Because the movie told one story. And there are so many more children waiting to be found.

Children like a young girl we'll call Kristen.

For months, she was locked in an attic.

No windows. No escape. Sold again and again.

**Until one day, she heard the sound of freedom. **

She knocked on a hotel room door.

She expected to find the person her trafficker had sent her to meet.

But when the door opened, Freedom Strike Force -- a rescue team we equip -- was waiting.

**She is safe today because someone cared enough to act**.

name: Republican Party of Minnesota
subject: A personal Thanksgiving thank-you from Alex Plechash
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Republican Party of Minnesota
body:
As my time as chairman draws to a close, I want to say thank you.

Republican Party of Minnesota

HAPPY THANKSGIVING

Dear Friends,

This Thanksgiving, as my time as chairman of the Republican Party of Minnesota draws to a close, I want you to know how grateful I
am for the opportunity you gave me to serve. I won't be seeking reelection in December, and before I hand the gavel to the next
chair, I want to say something that can get lost in the rush of a campaign. Thank you.

To everyone who put your name on the ballot this year, thank you. It takes courage to stand in front of your neighbors, tell them
what you believe, and ask for their vote. Whether you won or fell short, you gave Minnesotans a choice. To the families who shared
you with us through all those evenings and weekends, you have my gratitude, too.

As we gather around our tables, I'm especially thankful for the men and women who serve our country, for our veterans, and for the
families who have an empty seat this Thanksgiving because someone they love is on duty. Because generations of Americans have
answered the call to serve, we can worship freely, speak our minds, choose our leaders, and stand up for the rights and liberties
we want our children to inherit.

Here at home, I know this election season has left some hard feelings within our party. I'm grateful for the people who have

| | | | Peter, Happy Thanksgiving!
---
In my family, we have a tradition: before anyone touches the food, we go around the table and say what we’re grateful for. My parents started it, and it’s one of the ways they taught me that you never take the good things for granted.
So this year, I’m going first. And I’m grateful for you. 🧡
I’m grateful for the people who went above and beyond. Who gave when it wasn’t easy, knocked on doors, made calls, and reminded their neighbors that their vote mattered. Who didn’t wait for someone else to solve the problem. I couldn’t have done this without you, and I mean that.
You showed up for working families. You showed up for immigrant communities. You showed up for our democracy. And because of you, change is possible.
I’d say I’m _stuffed_ with gratitude, but let’s be honest, we’ve got plenty of room for more fighting after the pie. 🥧 I’m not finished, and I don’t plan on letting anyone talk turkey about slowing down. 🦃
**So from my table to yours: thank you for believing in this fight. I hope you’re surrounded by the people you love this week, with a full table and a full heart.**
Happy Thanksgiving,
Linda ❤️

subject: What I’m grateful for this Thanksgiving
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Phil Weiser for Colorado
body:
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/144103644/662424563/1239926708?refcode=ea.ee03750d-bfe9-f111-91f3-000d3a53319b&ms=ea.ee03750d-bfe9-f111-91f3-000d3a53319b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZTAzNzUwZC1iZmU5LWYxMTEtOTFmMy0wMDBkM2E1MzMxOWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=b_vTFwwgNgLZhwAZJSU3nbrQtMhHXeYUMKIqq1YEcVU=&emci=6e135a1e-44e4-f111-91f3-000d3a533978&emdi=ee03750d-bfe9-f111-91f3-000d3a53319b&ceid=51844520) If you ask me, folks, optimism won on November 3rd. In the last eighteen years, I can think of just one other election that has offered this kind of positive, almost too-good-to-be-true glow: 2008. I know cynicism can be common in electoral politics, and governing is often extremely serious business. I am of the firm belief that when things go well, however, it is important to be thankful and to take in the joy of the moment. The wave that swept across our state — and our entire nation — reminded me that we can do what seems impossible by doing it the right way. Eileen Laubacher defeated Lauren Boebert and flipped Colorado’s fourth district. Similarly, Jessica Killin flipped Colorado’s fifth district, which shifted over fourteen points toward Democrats after long being written off as deep red. Kevin Leung beat out a _lot_ of dark money to win a seat in the Colorado State Senate. _And this all happened because voters turned out, tuned out the dark money-fueled attacks, and elected candidates committed to delivering for them._ **This Thanksgiving season, I am profoundly grateful for the voters who made their voices clear, for fierce and determined candidates who ran when others said it was an impossible race, and everyone who leaned in to support authentic, people-powered campaigns. We now have the type of leadership we need to meet this moment and build the kind of future where we _all_ can thrive.** From my family to yours, I wish you a warm and fulfilling Thanksgiving holiday. May we all continue to share joy and optimism wherever and whenever we are able. With gratitude, Phil

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: Thanksgiving cheat sheet
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
This Thanksgiving, I know many of you will be sitting around a table with family and loved ones.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20261126-6993-footer&t=1&akid=6993%2E420207%2EV9umgW)
Hi Peter, Pramila Jayapal here.
This Thanksgiving, I know many of you will be sitting around a table with family and loved ones — some of whom may share your politics, and some of whom may not.
At my house, one question I _know_ I’m going to get is this: “Is Medicare For All ever actually going to happen?”
The answer is yes, if we keep talking about it! Two-thirds of Americans now support Medicare For All, the highest level ever polled. Your family is probably closer to “yes” than you think!
**That’s why I’ve put together a little “How to talk to your family about Medicare For All” cheat sheet for you:**
* _“How will we pay for it?”_ We already do. The United States spends about $15,500 per person on health care, roughly twice what other wealthy countries spend, and we still live shorter lives.

* _“Will I lose my doctor?”_ Nope. Under our bill, you choose any doctor you want. The only thing you lose is your insurance company’s denial letters.

* _“Won’t there be long waits for care?”_ No, and people are already going without care under our current system because it’s too expensive.

Above all else, be kind, listen more than you talk, and remember that you don’t have to win this debate today. You just have to plant the seed.
I hope you find this helpful, and that you have a safe and happy Thanksgiving!
In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal

This Thanksgiving is particularly meaningful for our family. After months on the campaign trail, countless conversations, knocking on doors, attending community events and meeting people from all walks of life, we have much to reflect upon and even more to be grateful for.
[Pledge your support](https://substack..Os_H4kYOD3Zf1CaLo-2ZoppF7dYnd10nesSSPyF7Vkc?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=226683961)
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1454853&post_id=226683961&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjI2NjgzOTYxLCJpYXQiOjE3OTU3MTU1MTAsImV4cCI6MTc5ODMwNzUxMCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTE0NTQ4NTMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.tfsxAhxK9ftSf3jhk2uyOjttDjsjbau9hOrDKHfOdxk)
_**While the election results were not what we had hoped for, gratitude is not measured in votes, and success is not measured solely by electoral victories.**_
As a father and son team who had the unique opportunity to run for public office during the same election cycle, we shared an experience that we will cherish for the rest of our lives.
We are incredibly grateful for our family, our friends, our volunteers and our supporters who invested their time, energy and resources in our campaigns. From those who made phone calls and knocked on doors to those who put up lawn signs, offered words of encouragement or simply kept us in their prayers, each of you made a difference.
We are equally grateful for the new friendships we developed along the way and for the meaningful conversations we had, even with those who did not necessarily agree with us politically.
**There is far more that unites us than divides us.**
Thanksgiving reminds us that our political differences should never overshadow our shared humanity, our love of family, our commitment to our communities or our appreciation for the freedoms we enjoy as Americans. We hope that carries through to the family dinners across this nation.
_**We are blessed to live in a country where a father and son can run for public office, speak freely, challenge the status quo and participate in the democratic process. We should never take those freedoms for granted.**_
An election may be over, but our commitment to public service, our community and the issues we care deeply about does not end on Election Day. There are many ways to make a difference without holding elected office.
Today, however, is not about politics. It is about appreciating the people who enrich our lives, remembering those who are less fortunate and recognizing the blessings that we sometimes overlook in the hustle and bustle of everyday life.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d6e3940a-ba5a-4411-92ae-f0f0878d8c4c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

As the Bible reminds us:
_" Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; his love endures forever."_ -- Psalm 107:1
From our family to yours, may your Thanksgiving be filled with love, laughter, good health, friendship and renewed hope for the future.
Thank you for being part of our journey and stay connected - the journey continues.
**Happy Thanksgiving, and may God bless you, your families and the United States of America.**
**Dr. Michael Goldstein & Jonathan Goldstein**

This Thanksgiving, I’m taking a moment to reflect on how grateful I am to be here, serving Iowa families and working toward a future that makes our kids and grandkids lives better.
I’m grateful for the people who have welcomed me into their homes, shared their stories, and trusted me to carry their concerns to Washington D.C. I’m grateful for the families who keep showing up for one another, even when the cost of living makes every decision harder. And I’m grateful for you, N/A, for standing with this campaign and believing that every person deserves the chance to thrive.
My faith teaches me that we are called to care for our neighbors, especially when they are struggling. That belief has guided my work to expand access to affordable insulin, protect mobile home residents, and make sure government serves people rather than powerful corporations.

Lindsay James

clean_body: = N/A, This Thanksgiving, I’m taking a moment to reflect on how grateful I am to be here, serving Iowa families and working toward a future that makes our kids and grandkids lives better. I’m grateful for the people who have welcomed me into their homes, shared their stories, and trusted me to carry their concerns to Washington D.C. I’m grateful for the families who keep showing up for one another, even when the cost of living makes every decision harder. And I’m grateful for you, N/A, for standing with this campaign and believing that every person deserves the chance to thrive. My faith teaches me that we are called to care for our neighbors, especially when they are struggling. That belief has guided my work to expand access to affordable insulin, protect mobile home residents, and make sure government serves people rather than powerful corporations. Today is about gratitude, family, and community. Thank you for being part of this community and for standing with working families. I hope your Thanksgiving is filled with peace, love, and time with the people who matter most. Lindsay James =

body:

---](https://us.list-manage.com/13dyRzjaevc?e=2ce0ad0449&c2id=45350b27067c85fdcb9eb8e5b2087927)
| | | | | | Hi Neighbor,

Happy Thanksgiving!
---
| |
As I reflect on this past year, I’m filled with gratitude. First and foremost, I’m thankful to the voters across our district who placed their trust in me and gave me the opportunity to serve the community I love. It is a responsibility I don't take lightly, and one that I will carry with me every day in Congress.
Rachel, our family, and I are also incredibly grateful to everyone who stood with us throughout this journey. Whether you knocked on doors, made phone calls, hosted an event, contributed to the campaign, or simply encouraged us along the way, you helped make this possible. Thank you.
This morning, I started Thanksgiving at the Napa Valley Turkey Trot, celebrating alongside families and neighbors who make this such a special place to call home.
From there, I'm spending the day traveling across our district and joining neighbors for community Thanksgiving celebrations. I'll be stopping in Yuba City for the Yuba City Community Thanksgiving Meal, visiting the Marysville Elks Lodge Community Thanksgiving Dinner, joining the Community Meals and Housing Thanksgiving celebration at St. Martin's Episcopal Church in Davis, and wrapping up the afternoon at the Sonoma Annual Community Thanksgiving Dinner at the Sonoma Veterans Memorial Hall.
It's a full day, but there is nowhere I'd rather be than spending time with the people and organizations that bring our communities together.
As I prepare to serve in Congress, I'm reminded that public service is about more than what happens in Washington. It's about showing up, listening, lending a hand, and making sure every community has someone fighting for its future.
I'm especially thankful for the volunteers, nonprofit organizations, faith leaders, first responders, local businesses, and neighbors who give so much of themselves to help others. They represent the very best of our district.
I am honored by the trust you've placed in me, grateful for the opportunity to give back to the community I love, and excited about what we can accomplish together.From Rachel, our kids, and me, we wish you and your families a wonderful
Thanksgiving filled with good food, good company, and plenty of reasons to be grateful.
With gratitude,

---
| |
**Eric Jones**

body:
On September 14th, the Church celebrates the Exaltation of the Holy Cross.
| | | | [](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=cdb1e4d068bb4c848da0be0cc542151b&_e=g4drlhIyiqgusSTBfVuYiiTzbpj8YTopRtoQhD4ug8VesBNWrpq2k7KyJF1UfbVRoPy4qXOxlYrqPue6aTSXenhAxfoG1LDtNzb_nB4IyM7nUgWHBku0-bjOdWo0aPUfOoYSC-17YRgijaJaPC4v5kIRm6Dhf5Dsg7DBYhOmNH0lbxXox9NJe-NiEV2H9GCu20FT1wGFI2MknftXfAVYwncFXGueOvOG_rMp5383WAPJBTKUVJgt8CkDw5j1hGqPUlhhsEdGwDbuSx4DCMHNOUC_xObk4z5ApWhlGm8KTEdyFUtvATfAYLNRg4QGQo3Qgi0z7XlntvsR3gbojXgLXmbbAG5lBCGGKORoLvcQAq1b4NiSdtH47UuFOBwLrlUM_jq4DM1_cXpwSIqYUrENwEuRJ8LNkqb_IWVeH5pVcAZQUBbjnmUmYTSigGjgD-TBoM4rvJ1d4E5KiDkpSKKGtbbEjSLzlzJ990i3azr3qUbTrmCysxtzf5r1I_DaW955jVr3gzhJQbjkg877xocQK0OXmETYiekMWwGQExWtzLEHODEAvP528iF4kxrNfMcmYspRZDs6dBLK-8Kj-cpAIlLm9OrxAUTe4mx7EPiAcSBBMhL3DJjYTdoFu4qk80P7lHhyFa_55H0i1Din3whlVCO1y9I6jtr2wdvfWHQrW5tM-Fyr4CCxS-PUwMLmN2EomV8ZGg_QPn6Ou4UYJsXMlomzFtvGV7RjZYPt4ul-bRMDI32rVbITmlKkHx3XLxlRJUqVPQkPBIQYf4xv6FmJbA%3D%3D)
---
Dear Peter,"We have no place to go." That's what Sister Francois-Dorothee tells me the poor children of the impoverished town of Matjieskloof in South Africa keep telling her. The situation isn't good. The children of Matjieskloof always had a hard life. It's a small town where most of the homes are made of tin siding and indoor plumbing is non-existent. But now things have gotten so much worse. At the start of this past year, schools in South Africa were still shut down and the kids literally had no place to go. With no air conditioning, internet, or even much space in their homes, staying inside hasn't been an option in the sweltering African heat. **So kids have taken to playing in the small garbage dumps that litter the town.** And those are the kids that haven't tragically fallen prey to alcohol, drugs, and other horrible things that the gangs of a nearby city peddle them. No one is watching these children and they have nowhere to go. **That's why the Oblate Sisters of Saint Francis de Sales want to give those children a place of their own.[And it's why I'm asking today if you'll help.](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=cdb1e4d068bb4c848da0be0cc542151b&_e=g4drlhIyiqgusSTBfVuYiiTzbpj8YTopRtoQhD4ug8VesBNWrpq2k7KyJF1UfbVRoPy4qXOxlYrqPue6aTSXenhAxfoG1LDtNzb_nB4IyM7nUgWHBku0-bjOdWo0aPUfOoYSC-17YRgijaJaPC4v5kIRm6Dhf5Dsg7DBYhOmNH0lbxXox9NJe-NiEV2H9GCu20FT1wGFI2MknftXfAVYwncFXGueOvOG_rMp5383WAPJBTKUVJgt8CkDw5j1hGqPUlhhsEdGwDbuSx4DCMHNOQsj1rmHb3Srj4gxxNW5SilwssJTASRTFJo_4cVBXOpFgk5GB3gg1CyssaPWsy6A7xD_NRQ2o610t4xf4SPnHRhEeRDAJ_4n8CoXgJOgV-ZxLebkRe3jpljuaBeL56_1fB6F3GAN3-6fCG6uZNR0eNxz92prxVEvxLgangG8d-ESfVK14X9wmwxT59NaVEGmt1C_jejZWiwN1Dqq4W0CmLsLwG3zVUb6j86L5nzhNiOyJK1QUtuex73AjKp4IMZNlFr0IWMHd3Az2i-eZmwGdyYq7KtK7HrMbXdD9NL1iQKW6f2oS_6NInTKyucG8McPzjukyWxuxXGOvB3Vll8koiJeYDn79GYJGkdJSXkARFI0AetLperfBVDBerYB7_LEYHP9DQ-hr8aZurO8du5udteFPpZx7hcYKFyTWb_co9KwxPOxTx7Bf0tWOaufi7fcpeIPY_alzRF3OnL0R5kJxv2MXBHuPwguCk3AEu9cbTNVG9nwxkK0uVgU2RW8bEkG9A%3D%3D "Original URL: https://trk.mg.digital-communication.-LYD3nltQfjN3wA Click to follow link.")** **Sister Francois-Dorothee — who leads our mission in Matjieskloof — has cleared off some land** **and started building an outdoor community center (with the help of some older children)...** **...so kids have a safe place to be kids.** The children in town are very excited and have been using their crayons to show how they would like this space to look. I wish you could see the beaming smiles on these children imagining what it would be like to have a place to play that isn't a garbage dump. But the Oblate Sisters would like this space to be so much more. We want this to be a place where children can be taught daily. Fed daily. And where our Sisters can pray with them daily. However, with just the Sisters and children themselves working on this center, progress has been moving far too slow. These children can't wait years. They're losing their childhoods right now. Unfortunately, it's not going to be cheap to hire professionals who can build quickly. And our Sisters in Matjieskloof just don't have that kind of money. **Which is why Sister Francois-Dorothee has asked me to reach out to people like you who might be able to help.** My name is Sister Anne Elizabeth Eder and I'm the North American Delegate for the Oblate Sisters of Saint Francis de Sales. Saint Leonie Aviat founded the Oblate Sisters of Saint Francis de Sales in 1866 after visiting a factory and seeing the harsh conditions that so many were working under. She knew that these least privileged in society especially needed to hear the words of Christ. Our mission in Matjieskloof was founded under her direction in 1885. **And in our 138 years in Matjieskloof, I'm not sure if the children there have ever needed our help more than now.** I know you're miles and miles away from these children, but today you can have a big impact on their lives. Specifically, I am asking you to do two things:
---
**1\. Will you pray for the children of Matjieskloof?** Please pray they find the strength to make it through the hardships of their daily lives. **2\. Will you send a one-time gift of $25** so we can finish building the urgently needed outdoor community center for the children of Matjieskloof — so our Oblate Sisters can continue to feed, educate, and pray with them?
---

Will you send a one-time gift of $25** so we can finish building the urgently needed outdoor community center for the children of Matjieskloof — so our Oblate Sisters can continue to feed, educate, and pray with them?
---
I understand that it might not be easy to spare much, especially right now. I would never want you to give money that you truly need for your own family. But I know we often spend $25 without really thinking about it on things we truly don't need. These children need you. [**That's why if you can afford to send a larger amount — say $35, $50, or even $100 — it would be most appreciated.** ](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=cdb1e4d068bb4c848da0be0cc542151b&_e=g4drlhIyiqgusSTBfVuYiiTzbpj8YTopRtoQhD4ug8VesBNWrpq2k7KyJF1UfbVRoPy4qXOxlYrqPue6aTSXenhAxfoG1LDtNzb_nB4IyM7nUgWHBku0-bjOdWo0aPUfOoYSC-17YRgijaJaPC4v5kIRm6Dhf5Dsg7DBYhOmNH0lbxXox9NJe-NiEV2H9GCu20FT1wGFI2MknftXfAVYwncFXGueOvOG_rMp5383WAPJBTKUVJgt8CkDw5j1hGqPUlhhsEdGwDbuSx4DCMHNOe9-OMT_YV9Hr87aFpnLCAdMcL-SbdQOi0oDYWoKac7UBXFgrAIRQY5Hy6zgJ5yvLaOv9YvIrUgY_UwB5TdwaNPF7Bl_QG_X7tEId7EUXppKWPLlou1zcKN97LmLxszWf2AUfhsggNn5naNaeMWgaTNdvXRvWHoQCX0k7pJy4Eb-RN7p5-hNklMpusjkkYhtUmDU2Y2ZxF1uXjjsr8H3EGhMVBEuU-mzAWE2eZ2Y0SGXgeXixRINh7W8748KqVvdUj8ivxeYQWyh2_K8DD5MZgunj_PKUnMk0FQFB2WEezVG7FFWIivmH1ylFdpuBOgZH5O0qIg_wMDwZVw71q53pyT2y6C_06kX3__mz-lgwR6zTnTwCairjJuF3HROWZ7KiSLs6Db3YSu9-jnVZLOaTichRCJLDc8BVgCqWZ66NPae7NXZWGQFtFQ6GqZZP2C0Uk0tl-LKBTY5PKBgDSKHtldG-QvHoACPmqinIyZt8i44Qqg-26rjgNLx31h0zU7seQ%3D%3D "Original URL: https://trk.mg.digital-communication. Click to follow link.") Please don't forget the words of our Savior: _"Whatever you did for one of these least brothers of mine, you did for me."_ So if you've been particularly blessed and can give a larger amount, I hope you'll consider gifts of $250, $500, $1,000, or even $10,000. But any gift will help us. **Whether you give $25 or $1,000, I thank you for helping shine light into the lives of these children.** You'll be in my prayers.
---
| | | **God bless,** Sr. Anne Elizabeth Eder, OSFSOblate Sisters of Saint Francis de Sales

We need to give them a safe place where they can be kids. **Please make a one-time contribution of $25 or more to help these children during this critical time.** God bless you for your generosity. clean_body: On September 14th, the Church celebrates the Exaltation of the Holy Cross. | | | | Dear Peter,"We have no place to go." That's what Sister Francois-Dorothee tells me the poor children of the impoverished town of Matjieskloof in South Africa keep telling her. The situation isn't good. The children of Matjieskloof always had a hard life. It's a small town where most of the homes are made of tin siding and indoor plumbing is non-existent. But now things have gotten so much worse. At the start of this past year, schools in South Africa were still shut down and the kids literally had no place to go. With no air conditioning, internet, or even much space in their homes, staying inside hasn't been an option in the sweltering African heat. So kids have taken to playing in the small garbage dumps that litter the town. And those are the kids that haven't tragically fallen prey to alcohol, drugs, and other horrible things that the gangs of a nearby city peddle them. No one is watching these children and they have nowhere to go. That's why the Oblate Sisters of Saint Francis de Sales want to give those children a place of their own. "Original URL: Click to follow link." Sister Francois-Dorothee — who leads our mission in Matjieskloof — has cleared off some land and started building an outdoor community center (with the help of some older children)... ...so kids have a safe place to be kids. The children in town are very excited and have been using their crayons to show how they would like this space to look. I wish you could see the beaming smiles on these children imagining what it would be like to have a place to play that isn't a garbage dump. But the Oblate Sisters would like this space to be so much more. We want this to be a place where children can be taught daily. Fed daily. And where our Sisters can pray with them daily. However, with just the Sisters and children themselves working on this center, progress has been moving far too slow. These children can't wait years. They're losing their childhoods right now. Unfortunately, it's not going to be cheap to hire professionals who can build quickly. And our Sisters in Matjieskloof just don't have that kind of money. Which is why Sister Francois-Dorothee has asked me to reach out to people like you who might be able to help. My name is Sister Anne Elizabeth Eder and I'm the North American Delegate for the Oblate Sisters of Saint Francis de Sales. Saint Leonie Aviat founded the Oblate Sisters of Saint Francis de Sales in 1866 after visiting a factory and seeing the harsh conditions that so many were working under. She knew that these least privileged in society especially needed to hear the words of Christ. Our mission in Matjieskloof was founded under her direction in 1885. And in our 138 years in Matjieskloof, I'm not sure if the children there have ever needed our help more than now. I know you're miles and miles away from these children, but today you can have a big impact on their lives. Specifically, I am asking you to do two things: 1\. Will you pray for the children of Matjieskloof? Please pray they find the strength to make it through the hardships of their daily lives. 2\. Will you send a one-time gift of $25 so we can finish building the urgently needed outdoor community center for the children of Matjieskloof — so our Oblate Sisters can continue to feed, educate, and pray with them? 1\. Will you pray for the children of Matjieskloof? Please pray they find the strength to make it through the hardships of their daily lives. 2\. Will you send a one-time gift of $25 so we can finish building the urgently needed outdoor community center for the children of Matjieskloof — so our Oblate Sisters can continue to feed, educate, and pray with them? I understand that it might not be easy to spare much, especially right now. I would never want you to give money that you truly need for your own family. But I know we often spend $25 without really thinking about it on things we truly don't need. These children need you. "Original URL: Click to follow link." Please don't forget the words of our Savior: "Whatever you did for one of these least brothers of mine, you did for me." So if you've been particularly blessed and can give a larger amount, I hope you'll consider gifts of $250, $500, $1,000, or even $10,000. But any gift will help us. Whether you give $25 or $1,000, I thank you for helping shine light into the lives of these children. You'll be in my prayers. | | | God bless, Sr. Anne Elizabeth Eder, OSFSOblate Sisters of Saint Francis de Sales | | | | | P.S. The children of Matjieskloof in South Africa have no place to go. They're literally playing in garbage dumps. We need to give them a safe place where they can be kids. Please make a one-time contribution of $25 or more to help these children during this critical time. God bless you for your generosity. I will be praying for you. subject: Happy Thanksgiving and Thank You
body:
907Honest.com for Alaska News, Politics, History, and more. | | | [](https://q8w2.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6b088dfdfcd9105d016658a5&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.907honest.com%2F%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D6b088d1fb61b8a429475ce49%26ss_email_id%3D6b088dfdfcd9105d016658a5%26ss_campaign_name%3DHappy%2BThanksgiving%2Band%2BThank%2BYou%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2026-11-26T19%253A52%253A44Z&w=69a52c74bc7495054af302fd&c=b_6b088d1fb61b8a429475ce49&l=en-US&s=cAC_09yRf_vlNG4QH903FXVO9Uw%3D)

|
#### **Happy Thanksgiving and A Huge Thank You from My Wife and I**
---
**A Thanksgiving Thank You — From the Road Since 2022 Friends, neighbors, and the thousands of Alaskans who have walked this road with me: On this Thanksgiving, before the plates are cleared and the lights come down, I want to stop and say it plainly: thank you. In 2022 I started a journey that most people said was impossible.** **Ranked-choice voting had just arrived, sold with nearly $7 million in mostly Outside money. I opened the 907Honest page, filed the first serious repeal petition, and asked ordinary Alaskans if they wanted their elections simple again — one person, one vote, most votes win. You answered. Hundreds of volunteers. More than 42,000 signatures. Court battles we won all the way to the Alaska Supreme Court.** **A $50,000 settlement from the people who tried to bury us. And on election night in 2024 we were ahead by thousands of votes — outspent 100-to-1 — only to lose by 743 ballots after two weeks of counting. The closest statewide race in modern Alaska history. That was not a loss of heart. That was proof that Alaskans will fight when the argument is clear and the effort is ours. In 2026 another group tried the full repeal of the entire 2020 package. They spent far more money and still lost by a wider margin.** **The lesson was expensive but useful: the open primary and the campaign-finance rules had become shields that protected ranked-choice voting itself. So we learned. We adjusted. Now the next petition is different. Surgical. Focused. It ends ranked-choice tabulation in general elections only. Voters pick one candidate. The candidate with the most votes wins. No multi-week counting. No exhausted ballots.** **The top-four primary stays. The dark-money disclosure rules stay. Ranked-choice voting will have to stand on its own merits — and I do not believe it can. Thousands of you have followed this page and this work. You shared the videos, signed the petitions, knocked the doors, wrote the checks, and kept the conversation alive when the big money tried to drown it. You turned a one-man effort into a movement that has already helped stop ranked-choice voting in other states and forced the other side to spend more than $32 million just to hold the line in Alaska.** **That is the thank-you. Not for following me — for standing up for a simple idea: Alaska’s elections belong to Alaskans.** **Enjoy the holidays. Rest. Eat. Be with your family and friends. The petitions for 2028 are being finished now. The film Frozen Odds is being completed. The data, the maps, and the message are sharper than they have ever been. The real work — signature gathering, organizing, and the long campaign — begins in earnest in 2027.** **Until the job is done, we keep going.** **Happy Thanksgiving. See you in the new year, ready to work.**

**Looking for leaders in Anchorage, West Alaska, and Southeast. We are breaking the project into districts with Captains / Leaders per district.**
---
### **How will 2028 Differ from 2024 and 2026 efforts?**
**Ranked Choice Voting is so popular in Alaska that it took nearly $7 million of 99%+ out-of-state money just to squeak it through in 2020.** **It was so popular in 2024 that it needed ~$15 million (again, ~99% out-of-state) to barely survive a repeal.** **It was so popular in 2026 that it needed another ~$10 million (still overwhelmingly out-of-state) to defend the system.** **That’s $32 million+ of mostly Outside money poured into keeping Ranked Choice Voting alive in Alaska — plus the $50k settlement from the 2025 legal fight against my repeal effort.** **Get ready for another $15 million in 2028. They’ll need it. This time we will break the petitions into two parts.** **—————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————** **The original bill 19AKBE was three parts, it was campaign finance rules (Stop Dark Money), it was Jungle Primary (Open Primary), and it was Ranked Choice Voting (RCV).** **The 2024 Effort (My Effort) Noticed the Campaign Finance Language as a Poison Pill, so I removed it from the Repeal Attempt, they ran ads saying we were trying to give power back to the polticial parties, which was effective, the graphic above shows the result, very close loss even though we were winning for 2 weeks after election day and had a 4,000 vote lead on election day.** **The 2026 Effort (Establishment GOP) tried to repeal the whole 19AKBE and failed very badly even though they raised significantly more money than I did.** **The new Effort targeting 2028 will break the Open Primary and RCV into two bills and run them at the same time in simple language, easily translated, no campaign finance language included.**

This holiday is a time for reflection, and despite the tough challenges facing us on the road ahead, I’m overwhelmed with gratitude for the blessings in my life.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/144109989/662438133/-1080040549?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ODBjZDgwMi1kNGU5LWYxMTEtOTFmMy0wMDBkM2E1MzMxOWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7FCL2brzp-oqjG7i3mNi_LSJ0jFRp9UsMIu0vhqEucY=) I hope you and your loved ones have a joyful and relaxing Thanksgiving! This holiday is a time for reflection, and despite the tough challenges facing us on the road ahead, I’m overwhelmed with gratitude for the blessings in my life. First and foremost, I’m thankful for you and this incredible community of supporters who make our work possible. I’m also grateful for the farmers and growers in our community whose hard work has made it possible for so many of us to put food on our tables today. **And I'm incredibly grateful to represent Oregon’s Sixth District.** It's the honor of a lifetime, and your faith in me is what allows us to keep fighting for the issues that matter most. Together, we’ve taken steps to lower costs, protect abortion rights, and build a fairer economy – and I know that together, we will keep up this fight in the coming months and years. While this work is not easy, I am more optimistic than ever about the progress we are going to make next year. Thank you for being part of this journey, and Happy Thanksgiving. Your support means everything to me, and I hope your day is filled with love, laughter, and maybe a second helping of pie. With gratitude, Andrea

# A Thanksgiving note from Drop Site
### None of this year's work would exist without you.
| | | [Ryan Grim](https://substack.com/@ryangrim)
---
| Nov 26
---
| [](https://substack.com/@ryangrim)
---
Two years ago, when we launched Drop Site News, we made a bet on the fundamental goodness and curiosity of the newsreading public. Our idea was that we could produce expensive, on-the-ground reporting that challenged prevailing narratives, publish all of it completely free as a non-profit venture, and people would pay for it anyway. It was our belief that news outlets misunderstand themselves as being in the business of making a product for consumers, exchanged in a commercial transaction.
Our theory is different: there's no shortage of content out there, and not enough hours in the day to get to it all. What's scarce is news reporting you can trust is being produced with only one goal in mind: the truth. People want that to exist, and they're willing to donate their hard-earned money so that it exists not just for themselves, but for everyone.
We wanted to send this note out on Thanksgiving as a sign of our gratitude. We bet on the goodness of our readers, and if anything, we underestimated what people are capable of doing. Oftentimes, when we ask you to support a project, you exceed the goal well before the deadline. With that in mind, I wanted to update you on how some of those projects have gone.
**The Gaza Journalist Fund:** In September 2025, we began raising money to support the Gaza Journalist Fund, and Drop Site readers kicked in more than $315,000, a sizable portion of our total budget. That money has been paid out to 68 journalists so far. It helps with relocations after the reporters' homes have been destroyed and with other life essentials as they battle through the kinds of everyday challenges most of us can't begin to imagine, all while producing reporting that keeps the world apprised of Israel's ongoing genocide.
**Matching for Gaza reporting:** This summer, three donors came together to put up $45,000 to match small-dollar contributions to support reporting in Gaza. Drop Site readers quickly donated $120,000, money that allowed us to expand our reporting on Palestine.
**Huda Skaik 's scholarship:** Also over the summer, we set out to raise $50,000 to support a scholarship for Palestinian journalist Huda Skaik, who'd been accepted to the University of London but needed to raise funds to travel from Gaza and live abroad. Instead of raising $50,000, Drop Site readers gave $79,000.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ef3b9bbb-c62b-4568-a1fe-1c71d910182c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Defending our reporting on the BBC:** When our journalist was sued in the United Kingdom for an article on the BBC and its coverage of Gaza, we set out to raise $250,000, but readers kicked in more than $330,000. We won a major procedural victory in the case. And while the case is ongoing, we expect a complete victory, which will set a major press freedom precedent in a country sorely lacking in press freedoms.
**Standing by our Mike Rogers investigation:** This fall, Republican Senate candidate Mike Rogers in Michigan threatened to sue us unless we retracted our investigation into him within five days. Drop Site readers quickly poured more than $50,000 into a legal defense fund, and we stood by the story.
**Areeba Fatima 's journey to Columbia:** In 2025, a young Pakistani journalist, Areeba Fatima, was accepted to Columbia's graduate journalism program but had no way to afford it. Drop Site readers donated more than $40,000, and against the odds, she secured a student visa. She walked across the stage in August of this year and soon begins a reporting fellowship with the Minnesota Star Tribune. Along the way, she produced some memorable investigations for Drop Site.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/027a9683-8cb4-40e1-8df7-b576c1d5f133?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Covering the new Congress:** Most recently, [we set a goal of raising $100,000 to expand our coverage of Capitol Hill](https://substack.com/redirect/35094f56-9df3-4c75-958e-4685090f7407?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) after the blue tsunami washed in a new generation of politicians. We've already exceeded it and hope to have an announcement on that front soon.
Add it all up and Drop Site readers have given more than $1 million to these projects, on top of keeping our daily reporting going.
We have big plans for 2027: a new Capitol Hill reporting operation and newsletter to cover the incoming Congress, more on-the-ground reporting from the places where the news is actually happening, and a big expansion of our video work. When we launched, we bet that our readers would carry this place, and that's still the deal. We'll only go as far as you're able to take us.
As the year winds down and you're deciding where to give, we hope you'll keep Drop Site in mind. Every donation is tax-deductible and goes straight into the reporting.
[Support Drop Site - Ways to Give ->](https://substack.com/redirect/94670a49-386e-46dd-82cb-402a62208840?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
So from all of us at Drop Site to all of you, please accept our endless thanks.
Happy Thanksgiving,
Ryan & the Drop Site team
(C) 2026 Drop Site News, Inc.
Drop Site News Inc., 1930 18th St NW
Ste B2 #1034, Washington, DC 20009

name: Andrew Sypher, Turning Point USA
subject: This is exactly what Charlie warned about
body:
I’m going to be blunt with you.

| | |
---
| | Friend,
---
I'm going to be blunt with you.

We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit.

Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way."

Right now.

And the scariest part?

It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms.

High schools. Colleges.

Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped.

If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: _" What happened to this country?" _

You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly.

Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything...

The other side is doing something far more dangerous.

They're raising the next generation.

Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places.

That's how countries are lost.

Slowly. Then all at once.

But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope...

There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged.

_And it shouldn 't even exist. _

**Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.**
That alone felt like a miracle.

Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have.

Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down.

And yet...

_They stepped up anyway. _

About that time, Charlie called me.

He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent.

"Andrew, we've got to move faster."

I told him we were. He stopped me.

"No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I actually laughed.

"Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said. "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000."

I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools.

We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet.

But Charlie wasn't fazed.

_" We'll figure it out." _

That was him.

He didn't wait for perfect conditions.

Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... _we lose everything. _

And now?

Less than a year later...
---
[](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckb2u2zAMhZ9G3hxI1F88eCgaGOhw79pRYCQ6FmrLriQ77dsXvskTdCPIw3PAjz8_3AfGOabHJy7U-yO6XFydYomF_qCv89_nhNVPmOdITwccTCtEC8ahr_EgJ5rQ-2AkNNQL22kLugPbTL0neQ_jVSkjLL8GkIBBK64hWGX0dWxif7oJAQa40iAvgpB3xKXgeNfBEFN83wJWKhe_pkL5wDMyprSe1Zoufl2auZ9q3QqT3xgMDIZCfs90wURhraeCwVD3nGJ6tNsaU233ggwG2-nxri21HXWyVRSw7Yhki-N1HDUJMoRMDmXdsyfn10BM3r7_-BRGWlAMzF4Xt1CI-8LkjRaM87v5WmHyNmEOWH459L_fI4_LhvGRmLzVbS_4ohjL8kX2LaqUT8sm92F7xnmOxVim-OOM-Dq5_t-jjh7-BQAA__9Ok6RG)
---
**We 're in 3,300 schools. **

**Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. **

**Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. **

_That shouldn 't be possible. _

Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day.

And yet... it's still happening.

_But Friend, here 's the part you need to understand: _

This is not a victory. It's a foothold.

_Because in the other 87% of schools? _

There is no resistance. None.

Just one-sided propaganda from the Left.

One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them.

That's the reality.

The question isn't whether we're fighting. We are.

The question is whether it's enough.

Because right now, the students stepping up through Club America...

They're not the majority. _They 're the exception. _

They're the ones willing to take the heat.

The ones willing to stand alone.

The ones willing to risk being targeted just to say: _" I love this country." _
---
[](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckb2u2zAMhZ9G3hxI1F88eCgaGOhw79pRYCQ6FmrLriQ77dsXvskTdCPIw3PAjz8_3AfGOabHJy7U-yO6XFydYomF_qCv89_nhNVPmOdITwccTCtEC8ahr_EgJ5rQ-2AkNNQL22kLugPbTL0neQ_jVSkjLL8GkIBBK64hWGX0dWxif7oJAQa40iAvgpB3xKXgeNfBEFN83wJWKhe_pkL5wDMyprSe1Zoufl2auZ9q3QqT3xgMDIZCfs90wURhraeCwVD3nGJ6tNsaU233ggwG2-nxri21HXWyVRSw7Yhki-N1HDUJMoRMDmXdsyfn10BM3r7_-BRGWlAMzF4Xt1CI-8LkjRaM87v5WmHyNmEOWH459L_fI4_LhvGRmLzVbS_4ohjL8kX2LaqUT8sm92F7xnmOxVim-OOM-Dq5_t-jjh7-BQAA__9Ok6RG)
---
And every time one of those students raises their hand...

We have a choice.

Back them. _Or leave them on their own. _

**Because when a student starts a chapter, we send them an activism kit -- with American flags. Pocket Constitutions. Leadership tools. **

Everything they need to actually stand their ground.

Not symbolically. For real.

They've already made the decision to lead.

All they're waiting on... is you and me.

**Each activism kit costs $25. That 's it. **

$25 to make sure one student doesn't have to stand alone against the Left in a hostile school.

$25 to put real tools in their hands.

$25 to push back -- even if it's one campus at a time.

**[And Friend, I'm asking you to send backup to these brave students on the frontlines with your gift to Turning Point USA today.](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckb2u2zAMhZ9G3hxI1F88eCgaGOhw79pRYCQ6FmrLriQ77dsXvskTdCPIw3PAjz8_3AfGOabHJy7U-yO6XFydYomF_qCv89_nhNVPmOdITwccTCtEC8ahr_EgJ5rQ-2AkNNQL22kLugPbTL0neQ_jVSkjLL8GkIBBK64hWGX0dWxif7oJAQa40iAvgpB3xKXgeNfBEFN83wJWKhe_pkL5wDMyprSe1Zoufl2auZ9q3QqT3xgMDIZCfs90wURhraeCwVD3nGJ6tNsaU233ggwG2-nxri21HXWyVRSw7Yhki-N1HDUJMoRMDmXdsyfn10BM3r7_-BRGWlAMzF4Xt1CI-8LkjRaM87v5WmHyNmEOWH459L_fI4_LhvGRmLzVbS_4ohjL8kX2LaqUT8sm92F7xnmOxVim-OOM-Dq5_t-jjh7-BQAA__9Ok6RG)**

Club America isn't slowing down. It's accelerating.

Because every day, more students are stepping forward.

Not because it's easy or popular...

_But because they know what 's at stake. _

They're starting chapters in schools where they were told not to.

They're speaking truth in classrooms where the Left once went unchallenged.

They're choosing courage in places designed to make them conform.

And they're not alone.

They're finding each other. They're bringing more students with them every day.

They're building something real -- rooted in faith and freedom, grounded in truth, and unafraid to say that America is worth defending.

That's how movements are built.

Not from the top down... _But from the ground up. _

One student. One school. One chapter at a time.

And Friend -- that's exactly how we take this country back.

But only if we move fast enough.

Because the Left isn't slowing down. They're not taking a break.

They're not afraid to push their anti-American ideas in every classroom they're in.

And if we don't match that urgency... if we don't meet that moment with equal conviction...

Then the generational window Charlie Kirk opened to save our country closes.

And once it closes... It closes for good.

That's what's at stake.

Let's not waste this moment. Let's back our brave students -- _while it still matters. _

**P.S.** I need you to hear this clearly...

Charlie Kirk wasn't just dreaming big when he called me last year about Club America's progress.

He was warning us:

"The enemy is moving younger. They're coming after students earlier. **_We don 't have time to wait._" **

And he was right. Look around.

Club America may be in 13% of high schools...

_But in the other 87%? _

There is no pushback against the Left.

No one telling those kids the truth.

Just a Leftist pipeline -- from classroom... to belief... to voting booth.

And once that pipeline is complete... _It 's over. _

**Friend, this is one of the last places a patriot like you can stop it before it 's too late to save our country. **

You may not be able to step into a hostile high school and stand for truth like these students do.

But you can give critical support to a young freedom fighter who will.

**[Every $25 you give today puts the tools in the hands of another student who's already chosen courage.](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckb2u2zAMhZ9G3hxI1F88eCgaGOhw79pRYCQ6FmrLriQ77dsXvskTdCPIw3PAjz8_3AfGOabHJy7U-yO6XFydYomF_qCv89_nhNVPmOdITwccTCtEC8ahr_EgJ5rQ-2AkNNQL22kLugPbTL0neQ_jVSkjLL8GkIBBK64hWGX0dWxif7oJAQa40iAvgpB3xKXgeNfBEFN83wJWKhe_pkL5wDMyprSe1Zoufl2auZ9q3QqT3xgMDIZCfs90wURhraeCwVD3nGJ6tNsaU233ggwG2-nxri21HXWyVRSw7Yhki-N1HDUJMoRMDmXdsyfn10BM3r7_-BRGWlAMzF4Xt1CI-8LkjRaM87v5WmHyNmEOWH459L_fI4_LhvGRmLzVbS_4ohjL8kX2LaqUT8sm92F7xnmOxVim-OOM-Dq5_t-jjh7-BQAA__9Ok6RG)**

clean_body: I’m going to be blunt with you. | | | | | Friend, I'm going to be blunt with you. We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit. Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way." Right now. And the scariest part? It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms. High schools. Colleges. Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped. If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: " What happened to this country?" You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly. Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything... The other side is doing something far more dangerous. They're raising the next generation. Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places. That's how countries are lost. Slowly. Then all at once. But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope... There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged. And it shouldn 't even exist. Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools. That alone felt like a miracle. Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have. Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down. And yet... They stepped up anyway. About that time, Charlie called me. He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent. "Andrew, we've got to move faster." I told him we were. He stopped me. "No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools." I actually laughed. "Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America." "Okay," he said. "How many are there?" "About 27,000." And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000." I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet. But Charlie wasn't fazed. " We'll figure it out." That was him. He didn't wait for perfect conditions. Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... we lose everything. And now? Less than a year later... We 're in 3,300 schools. Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. That shouldn 't be possible. Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day. And yet... it's still happening. But Friend, here 's the part you need to understand: This is not a victory. It's a foothold. Because in the other 87% of schools? There is no resistance. None. Just one-sided propaganda from the Left. One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them. That's the reality. The question isn't whether we're fighting. We are. The question is whether it's enough. Because right now, the students stepping up through Club America... They're not the majority. They 're the exception. They're the ones willing to take the heat. The ones willing to stand alone. The ones willing to risk being targeted just to say: " I love this country." And every time one of those students raises their hand... We have a choice. Back them. Or leave them on their own. Because when a student starts a chapter, we send them an activism kit -- with American flags. Pocket Constitutions. Leadership tools. Everything they need to actually stand their ground. Not symbolically. For real. They've already made the decision to lead. All they're waiting on... is you and me. Each activism kit costs $25. That 's it. $25 to make sure one student doesn't have to stand alone against the Left in a hostile school. $25 to put real tools in their hands. $25 to push back -- even if it's one campus at a time. But here's what gives me hope, Friend... Club America isn't slowing down. It's accelerating. Because every day, more students are stepping forward. Not because it's easy or popular... But because they know what 's at stake. They're starting chapters in schools where they were told not to. They're speaking truth in classrooms where the Left once went unchallenged. They're choosing courage in places designed to make them conform. And they're not alone. They're finding each other. They're bringing more students with them every day. They're building something real -- rooted in faith and freedom, grounded in truth, and unafraid to say that America is worth defending. That's how movements are built. Not from the top down... But from the ground up. One student. One school. One chapter at a time. And Friend -- that's exactly how we take this country back. But only if we move fast enough. Because the Left isn't slowing down. They're not taking a break. They're not afraid to push their anti-American ideas in every classroom they're in. And if we don't match that urgency... if we don't meet that moment with equal conviction... Then the generational window Charlie Kirk opened to save our country closes. And once it closes... It closes for good. That's what's at stake. Let's not waste this moment. Let's back our brave students -- while it still matters. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. I need you to hear this clearly... Charlie Kirk wasn't just dreaming big when he called me last year about Club America's progress. He was warning us: "The enemy is moving younger. They're coming after students earlier. We don 't have time to wait." And he was right. Look around. Club America may be in 13% of high schools... But in the other 87%? There is no pushback against the Left. No one telling those kids the truth. Just a Leftist pipeline -- from classroom... to belief... to voting booth. And once that pipeline is complete... It 's over. Friend, this is one of the last places a patriot like you can stop it before it 's too late to save our country. You may not be able to step into a hostile high school and stand for truth like these students do. But you can give critical support to a young freedom fighter who will. There's still time to turn this country around... and this is one of the few ways we can actually do it -- one student, one school, one chapter at a time. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044 Pop Acta Media | Conservative Innovation PO Box 461 Fort Collins, CO 80522 |

body:
I hope you get to spend today with good food, the people you love, and a chance to reflect on everything you are grateful for from the past year.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=41655%2E3422442%2E1CyX03)
Happy Thanksgiving, Peter!
Like I do every year, I’m spending today surrounded by loved ones, thinking about the things I’m most grateful for in my life.
First and foremost, I’m thankful for my family. Being a mom is such a huge joy, and spending another year watching my kids grow into wonderful young people has been so rewarding.
I’m also grateful for the incredible books and authors that bring so much color to my life. I’ve always been an avid reader, but I’ve found a renewed love for books this year (you can see some of my favorites over on my Instagram, [@KatiePorterTurnsThePage)](https://act.katieporter.com/go/22144?t=2&akid=41655%2E3422442%2E1CyX03).
Finally, I’m grateful for the direction our country is heading in after the midterm elections—and for grassroots supporters like you who made it possible. Truth to Power was behind many of the candidates who are going to fill Congress with champions for working families. I’m so proud of the work we did, and I’m deeply appreciative of your support.
I hope you get to spend today with good food, the people you love, and a chance to reflect on everything you are grateful for from the past year.
With gratitude,
– Katie Porter

name: Eddie Gallagher, Pipe Hitter Foundation
subject: Green Beret denied access to his own money
body:
Stand with him against a broken system

| | | |
---
| | | Friend,
---
My name is Eddie Gallagher.I served nearly 20 years as a Navy SEAL. Eight combat deployments. Two Bronze Stars. And on September 11, 2018, I was arrested and charged with war crimes.I'm writing to you today because another warrior is now standing where I once stood. _And he needs help._
---
[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2unDAQhZ_GdHflf6BwEQnR3RRRpJTWYM-CtWAT25Dk7SPIPkHaOaPvmzk_Pu0nhDXE-StsaHJ92lzsnBHjhBmrxxjQg3NYSk2L5ZTrD8Y-uLbgajjRSmi88c4Dcw0a1vaq5b3iullMp7qp85OUeuoQVK8E05KqvuVa0150TTAXjzGuOZOKq4dkHWtbylhPOyekJJLCirk-Mu7HtAYHsUJ5PVN2-HBpa1az1LoXIr4QPhI--hRTntLvR8oz4eO-PO18-vtsC-4nEeNRN-tSrBgrEcO37yPTshWUcH0lG_pwbEQMuEFY38OSjuyQiGGB7KG8btK_yMG2Q5gjEcPtghhTPCH6Py-8re-9ivmiNtn4_VdY11B0SySdL8v9SP3P7k_D_wYAAP__H6OUgA)
---
**Meet Gannon Van Dyke.** Gannon has served this country for 18 years as a Green Beret.Federal prosecutors have charged him in a first-of-its-kind case over bets placed on a prediction market. Gannon maintains his innocence.**His trial starts December 7 in New York.** To prepare his defense, he has to move there. He has to find a place to live, pay rent, buy groceries, and keep the lights on. **And he has to do it with NO access to his own money. His assets are frozen.**_He hasn 't had his day in court, and he's already paying the price._Friend, I know what that feels like.
---
[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2unDAQhZ_GdHflf6BwEQnR3RRRpJTWYM-CtWAT25Dk7SPIPkHaOaPvmzk_Pu0nhDXE-StsaHJ92lzsnBHjhBmrxxjQg3NYSk2L5ZTrD8Y-uLbgajjRSmi88c4Dcw0a1vaq5b3iullMp7qp85OUeuoQVK8E05KqvuVa0150TTAXjzGuOZOKq4dkHWtbylhPOyekJJLCirk-Mu7HtAYHsUJ5PVN2-HBpa1az1LoXIr4QPhI--hRTntLvR8oz4eO-PO18-vtsC-4nEeNRN-tSrBgrEcO37yPTshWUcH0lG_pwbEQMuEFY38OSjuyQiGGB7KG8btK_yMG2Q5gjEcPtghhTPCH6Py-8re-9ivmiNtn4_VdY11B0SySdL8v9SP3P7k_D_wYAAP__H6OUgA)
---
After my arrest, I spent months in pretrial confinement while the system tried to brand me a war criminal. My wife, Andrea, and my brother, Sean, fought for me every single day on the outside.Then Americans across the country started speaking up. They made calls, wrote letters, and gave what they could.In 2019, a jury found me NOT GUILTY of murder.During that fight, my family made a promise: if we made it through, we'd turn around and help the next warrior.**That 's why Andrea and I founded the Pipe Hitter Foundation in 2020 with the unwavering support of patriots like you, Friend, who wanted to fight alongside us against a broken system. **A "pipe hitter" is someone you want beside you when things get hard. Someone who has your back, no matter what.That's what we are for the people who protect us:
---
* Service members and veterans
* Law enforcement officers
* First responders
* And their families

---
When a broken system turns on them, we step in. We provide financial support, help with their legal defense, and stand with them publicly to spread their story. Since we started, we've invested more than **$3.7 MILLION** in warriors and their families.92% of every dollar goes to our programs. We hold a 4-star rating from Charity Navigator and the GuideStar Gold Seal of Transparency.When you give to Pipe Hitter Foundation, your gift goes where it's needed.**And here 's where you come in, Friend.**
---
[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2unDAQhZ_GdHflf6BwEQnR3RRRpJTWYM-CtWAT25Dk7SPIPkHaOaPvmzk_Pu0nhDXE-StsaHJ92lzsnBHjhBmrxxjQg3NYSk2L5ZTrD8Y-uLbgajjRSmi88c4Dcw0a1vaq5b3iullMp7qp85OUeuoQVK8E05KqvuVa0150TTAXjzGuOZOKq4dkHWtbylhPOyekJJLCirk-Mu7HtAYHsUJ5PVN2-HBpa1az1LoXIr4QPhI--hRTntLvR8oz4eO-PO18-vtsC-4nEeNRN-tSrBgrEcO37yPTshWUcH0lG_pwbEQMuEFY38OSjuyQiGGB7KG8btK_yMG2Q5gjEcPtghhTPCH6Py-8re-9ivmiNtn4_VdY11B0SySdL8v9SP3P7k_D_wYAAP__H6OUgA)
---
Right now, we're working to cover Gannon's move and living expenses so he can focus on one thing: preparing for trial.But we can't do it alone._**[Will you give $25, $50, or $100 today to help Gannon get to trial?](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2unDAQhZ_GdHflf6BwEQnR3RRRpJTWYM-CtWAT25Dk7SPIPkHaOaPvmzk_Pu0nhDXE-StsaHJ92lzsnBHjhBmrxxjQg3NYSk2L5ZTrD8Y-uLbgajjRSmi88c4Dcw0a1vaq5b3iullMp7qp85OUeuoQVK8E05KqvuVa0150TTAXjzGuOZOKq4dkHWtbylhPOyekJJLCirk-Mu7HtAYHsUJ5PVN2-HBpa1az1LoXIr4QPhI--hRTntLvR8oz4eO-PO18-vtsC-4nEeNRN-tSrBgrEcO37yPTshWUcH0lG_pwbEQMuEFY38OSjuyQiGGB7KG8btK_yMG2Q5gjEcPtghhTPCH6Py-8re-9ivmiNtn4_VdY11B0SySdL8v9SP3P7k_D_wYAAP__H6OUgA)**_
---
[ **Stand With Gannon Today**](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2unDAQhZ_GdHflf6BwEQnR3RRRpJTWYM-CtWAT25Dk7SPIPkHaOaPvmzk_Pu0nhDXE-StsaHJ92lzsnBHjhBmrxxjQg3NYSk2L5ZTrD8Y-uLbgajjRSmi88c4Dcw0a1vaq5b3iullMp7qp85OUeuoQVK8E05KqvuVa0150TTAXjzGuOZOKq4dkHWtbylhPOyekJJLCirk-Mu7HtAYHsUJ5PVN2-HBpa1az1LoXIr4QPhI--hRTntLvR8oz4eO-PO18-vtsC-4nEeNRN-tSrBgrEcO37yPTshWUcH0lG_pwbEQMuEFY38OSjuyQiGGB7KG8btK_yMG2Q5gjEcPtghhTPCH6Py-8re-9ivmiNtn4_VdY11B0SySdL8v9SP3P7k_D_wYAAP__H6OUgA)
---
Friend, when you give, you're not just helping one warrior. You're joining Americans nationwide who refuse to let our heroes stand alone.We step in. We fight. We have their six.I hope you'll stand with us.
---
Eddie Gallagher
Co-Founder & Director of Operations
Pipe Hitter Foundation
---
**P.S.** Friend, Green Beret Gannon Van Dyke's trial starts December 7, and the move to New York can't wait. _**[Help him walk into that courtroom ready to fight.](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2unDAQhZ_GdHflf6BwEQnR3RRRpJTWYM-CtWAT25Dk7SPIPkHaOaPvmzk_Pu0nhDXE-StsaHJ92lzsnBHjhBmrxxjQg3NYSk2L5ZTrD8Y-uLbgajjRSmi88c4Dcw0a1vaq5b3iullMp7qp85OUeuoQVK8E05KqvuVa0150TTAXjzGuOZOKq4dkHWtbylhPOyekJJLCirk-Mu7HtAYHsUJ5PVN2-HBpa1az1LoXIr4QPhI--hRTntLvR8oz4eO-PO18-vtsC-4nEeNRN-tSrBgrEcO37yPTshWUcH0lG_pwbEQMuEFY38OSjuyQiGGB7KG8btK_yMG2Q5gjEcPtghhTPCH6Py-8re-9ivmiNtn4_VdY11B0SySdL8v9SP3P7k_D_wYAAP__H6OUgA)**_
